info.name: Giftify API - COMP229 Project Part 1 (Team Mark)
info.description: Run the whole collection in order (Collection Runner). Three test users are created: Ava (list owner), Ben (approved follower) and Cleo (not a follower). Run "npm run seed" first so the admin account exists.

exec: // Unique suffix so the collection can be re-run without 'already exists' errors
pm.test('New users get the user role', () => pm.expect(u.role).to.eql('user'));

item.name: POST sign up Cleo (not a follower)

exec: pm.test('Cannot make yourself admin at sign up', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().user.role).to.eql('user'));

item.name: GET Ava's profile as Cleo (public fields only)
POST Ben requests to follow Ava
POST Cleo requests to follow Ava
GET Ben sees his sent request
GET Ben can't see Ava's lists while pending (403)
PUT Ben tries to accept his own request (403)
GET Ava's profile as Ben (followStatus accepted)

exec: pm.test('Ben is the only follower', () => { const l = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(l.length).to.eql(1); pm.expect(l[0].user._id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('benId')); });

item.name: GET Ava's followers as Cleo - private (403)

exec: pm.test('Two lists with item counts', () => { const l = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(l.length).to.eql(2); pm.expect(l[0]).to.have.property('itemCount'); });

item.name: GET Ava's wish lists as Ben (approved follower)
GET Ava's wish lists as Cleo - not a follower (403)
GET one of Ava's lists as Cleo (403)
POST Ben adds item to Ava's list (403)
GET items on list (sorted by priority)

exec: pm.test('Claimed by me', () => { const i = pm.response.json().item; pm.expect(i.isClaimed).to.eql(true); pm.expect(i.claimedByMe).to.eql(true); });

item.name: POST Ava claims her own item (400)
POST Cleo claims - not a follower (403)
GET items as Ava - claims are HIDDEN

exec: pm.test('Owner sees no claim info at all', () => pm.response.json().forEach(i => { pm.expect(i).to.not.have.property('isClaimed'); pm.expect(i).to.not.have.property('claimedBy'); pm.expect(i).to.not.have.property('claimedByMe'); }));

item.name: GET item 1 as Ava - claim HIDDEN
GET items as Ben - sees what is taken

exec: pm.test('Item 1 shows as claimed by me', () => { const i = l.find(x => x._id === pm.collectionVariables.get('item1Id')); pm.expect(i.isClaimed).to.eql(true); pm.expect(i.claimedByMe).to.eql(true); });
pm.test('Other items available', () => l.filter(x => x._id !== pm.collectionVariables.get('item1Id')).forEach(i => pm.expect(i.isClaimed).to.eql(false)));
pm.test('Claimer id is never exposed', () => l.forEach(i => pm.expect(i).to.not.have.property('claimedBy')));

pm.test('One claimed gift with owner + list info', () => { const l = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(l.length).to.eql(1); pm.expect(l[0].owner.name).to.eql('Ava Chen'); pm.expect(l[0].wishlist).to.have.property('title'); });
